product: alt-context WP plugin admin SPA — describe run GPU tier + lifecycle state
goals: Operator can start a bulk describe run and always see whether the GPU tier is stopped, warming, ready, or degraded (INT-10 status–predict–stop).
A cold GPU start (~90–100 s measured, VLM-3B decision 2266) is a bounded, cancellable wait, never a silent hang (INT-08, CARD-09).
Provisional CPU drafts and final GPU descriptions are visibly distinct at the item and run level (HAI-05, HAI-08, PROV-06).
GPU cost boundary is disclosed before commitment; user is never surprised by a $2/GPU-hr start (INT-07, CARD-15, COST-10).

jobs.label: Describe selected media with AI and apply results
Describe one image from the dashboard panel
Know which tier produced a description and what it will cost/take

screens.title: Workbench › Media selection
screens.purpose: Select media, launch a bulk describe run, watch progress including GPU tier state.

screens.title: Workbench › Describe run › Review & apply
screens.purpose: Review per-item drafts, see tier per item, apply to media.

screens.title: Toast — GPU tier transition
screens.purpose: One-shot notification for a tier transition the operator is NOT looking at (navigated away or terminal). Never a per-poll toast.

flows.label: Bulk describe when GPU is stopped

steps.branch_label: select → CTA shows 'GPU will warm (~2 min)' (gpu-cold-preview)
run queued → gpu-starting → gpu-warming (bounded ETA, Cancel)
CPU provisional drafts arrive → describing-provisional; 'Use CPU drafts now' offered
only if operator left the screen: success-final-ready

flows.label: GPU fails to come up / unreachable

steps.branch_label: gpu-warming exceeds bound (>180 s) or endpoint unreachable → degraded-cpu
partial-provisional; z-upgrade-notice explains no upgrade coming

flows.label: Dashboard single describe on GPU tier

steps.branch_label: submit → result; z-provenance shows Adapter=gpu_qwen30b, Model
GPU stopped → z-inline-error gpu-unreachable names the state + what to do

open_questions: Should the WP operator ever get an explicit 'Start GPU' / 'Stop GPU' control (HAI-04 activate–operate–override), or is warm-on-enqueue + idle reap the only lifecycle (DEMO-UX-1-GPU-01 proposes enqueue-triggered start)? Current recommendation: no manual control in the plugin; CTA discloses the cost and lifecycle is implicit.
gpu_state source of truth: lifecycle reaper writes /run/acx/gpu-state.json vs API probes ACX_GPU_ENDPOINT_URL/health. One writer only (DATA-14).
Toast when the operator IS on the progress screen: suppress (double announcement with the polite live region, A11Y-21) — confirm with a screen-reader pass.
not_doing: No confirm tab / modal before bulk describe (workbench not-doing inherited); cost disclosure lives in the CTA label + CTA hint.
No per-poll toasts; no toast for provisional→final per item.
No GPU cost meter in the plugin (billing is operator-side, OCI).
